summary: Equinox Gold filed a 6-K containing a management information circular for a special meeting to approve its proposed business combination with Orla Mining. Equinox Gold will acquire Orla Mining in a transformative merger expected to produce ~1.1M oz gold in 2026 from North American assets. The filing states no price per share or premium; the combined entity will be the second-largest Canadian gold producer. The board recommends the deal, and Chair Ross Beaty will step down upon completion. Shareholders vote July 22, 2026. Watch for regulatory approvals and shareholder vote as key risk-arb conditions.
